s3.name: Simple Storage Service (S3)
s3.description: Object storage service that offers industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance. Store and retrieve any amount of data from anywhere on the web with 99.999999999% (11 9's) durability.
s3.use_cases:
• Hosting static websites
• Data backup and archiving
• Data lakes for analytics
• Content distribution

ec2.name: Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2)
ec2.description: Secure and resizable compute capacity in the cloud. Virtual servers that can be launched in minutes with complete control over computing resources including CPU, memory, storage, and networking.
ec2.use_cases:
• Web application hosting
• Batch processing
• High-performance computing
• Development and testing environments

lambda.name: Lambda
lambda.description: Serverless compute service that runs code without provisioning or managing servers. Pay only for compute time consumed - no charge when code isn't running. Automatically scales from a few requests per day to thousands per second.
lambda.use_cases:
• Event-driven processing
• Data transformation
• Microservices architecture
• Automation tasks

dynamodb.name: DynamoDB
dynamodb.description: Fast and flexible NoSQL database service for applications that need consistent, single-digit millisecond latency at any scale. Fully managed with built-in security, backup and restore, and in-memory caching.
dynamodb.use_cases:
• Mobile and web applications
• Gaming applications
• IoT applications
• Real-time personalization

rds.name: Relational Database Service (RDS)
rds.description: Managed relational database service that makes it easy to set up, operate, and scale databases in the cloud. Supports multiple database engines including MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and SQL Server.
rds.use_cases:
• Web and mobile applications
• E-commerce applications
• Online gaming
• Enterprise applications

sns.name: Simple Notification Service (SNS)
sns.description: Fully managed messaging service for both application-to-application (A2A) and application-to-person (A2P) communication. Provides high-throughput, push-based, many-to-many messaging.
sns.use_cases:
• Application alerts and notifications
• Push notifications to mobile devices
• Email and SMS messaging
• Microservices decoupling

sqs.name: Simple Queue Service (SQS)
sqs.description: Fully managed message queuing service that enables decoupling and scaling of microservices, distributed systems, and serverless applications. Eliminates complexity and overhead of managing message-oriented middleware.
sqs.use_cases:
• Decoupling application components
• Work queue processing
• Batch job processing
• Load leveling

cloudfront.name: CloudFront
cloudfront.description: Fast content delivery network (CDN) service that securely delivers data, videos, applications, and APIs to customers globally with low latency and high transfer speeds. Integrates with other AWS services.
cloudfront.use_cases:
• Website acceleration
• Video streaming
• API acceleration
• Software distribution

iam.name: Identity and Access Management (IAM)
iam.description: Web service that helps securely control access to AWS resources. Create and manage AWS users and groups, and use permissions to allow and deny access to AWS resources.
iam.use_cases:
• User access management
• Role-based access control
• Multi-factor authentication
• Cross-account access

cloudwatch.name: CloudWatch
cloudwatch.description: Monitoring and observability service that provides data and actionable insights to monitor applications, respond to system-wide performance changes, and optimize resource utilization.
cloudwatch.use_cases:
• Application monitoring
• Infrastructure monitoring
• Log management
• Performance optimization

route53.name: Route 53
route53.description: Highly available and scalable cloud Domain Name System (DNS) web service. Route end users to Internet applications by translating domain names into IP addresses.
route53.use_cases:
• Domain registration
• DNS routing
• Health checking
• Traffic management

vpc.name: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
vpc.description: Virtual network dedicated to your AWS account. Logically isolated from other virtual networks in the AWS Cloud. Complete control over virtual networking environment including IP address ranges, subnets, and security settings.
vpc.use_cases:
• Network isolation
• Hybrid cloud connectivity
• Multi-tier applications
• Secure application hosting

efs.name: Elastic File System (EFS)
efs.description: Fully managed, elastic, shared file system for use with AWS Cloud services and on-premises resources. Scales automatically to petabytes without disrupting applications.
efs.use_cases:
• Content repositories
• Development environments
• Database backups
• Container storage

cloudformation.name: CloudFormation
cloudformation.description: Infrastructure as code service that helps model and set up AWS resources using templates. Spend less time managing resources and more time focusing on applications that run in AWS.
cloudformation.use_cases:
• Infrastructure automation
• Environment consistency
• Resource management
• Disaster recovery

apigateway.name: API Gateway
apigateway.description: Fully managed service that makes it easy to create, publish, maintain, monitor, and secure APIs at any scale. Acts as a front door for applications to access data, business logic, or functionality from backend services.
apigateway.use_cases:
• REST API creation
• WebSocket APIs
• API security and throttling
• Request/response transformation

eks.name: Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS)
eks.description: Managed Kubernetes service that makes it easy to run Kubernetes on AWS without needing to install and operate your own Kubernetes control plane or nodes.
eks.use_cases:
• Container orchestration
• Microservices deployment
• Hybrid deployments
• Machine learning workflows

fargate.name: Fargate
fargate.description: Serverless compute engine for containers that works with both Amazon ECS and Amazon EKS. Run containers without managing servers or clusters. Pay only for resources required to run containers.
fargate.use_cases:
• Serverless containers
• Microservices
• Batch processing
• CI/CD pipelines

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.description: MySQL and PostgreSQL-compatible relational database built for the cloud. Up to 5x faster than standard MySQL and 3x faster than standard PostgreSQL with automatic scaling and high availability.
aurora.use_cases:
• High-performance applications
• SaaS applications
• Distributed applications
• Enterprise workloads

athena.name: Athena
athena.description: Interactive query service that makes it easy to analyze data in Amazon S3 using standard SQL. Serverless, so no infrastructure to manage, and pay only for queries run.
athena.use_cases:
• Data lake analytics
• Log analysis
• Business intelligence
• Ad-hoc querying

glue.name: Glue
glue.description: Fully managed extract, transform, and load (ETL) service that makes it easy to prepare and load data for analytics. Automatically discovers and profiles data via the Glue Data Catalog.
glue.use_cases:
• Data preparation
• Data cataloging
• ETL workflows
• Data lake formation

sagemaker.name: SageMaker
sagemaker.description: Fully managed service that provides developers and data scientists with the ability to build, train, and deploy machine learning models quickly. Removes heavy lifting from each step of the ML process.
sagemaker.use_cases:
• Machine learning model development
• Model training and tuning
• Model deployment
• MLOps workflows

cognito.name: Cognito
cognito.description: User identity and data synchronization service that enables secure user sign-up, sign-in, and access control to web and mobile apps. Scales to millions of users and integrates with social identity providers.
cognito.use_cases:
• User authentication
• User management
• Social sign-in
• Mobile app backends

eventbridge.name: EventBridge
eventbridge.description: Serverless event bus that makes it easier to build event-driven applications at scale using events generated from applications, integrated Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) applications, and AWS services.
eventbridge.use_cases:
• Application integration
• Event-driven architectures
• SaaS integration
• Workflow automation

secretsmanager.name: Secrets Manager
secretsmanager.description: Helps protect secrets needed to access applications, services, and IT resources. Easily rotate, manage, and retrieve database credentials, API keys, and other secrets throughout their lifecycle.
secretsmanager.use_cases:
• Database credential management
• API key rotation
• Application secrets
• Compliance requirements

cloudtrail.name: CloudTrail
cloudtrail.description: Service that enables governance, compliance, operational auditing, and risk auditing of AWS account. Log, continuously monitor, and retain account activity related to actions across AWS infrastructure.
cloudtrail.use_cases:
• Security analysis
• Resource change tracking
• Compliance auditing
• Operational troubleshooting

kms.name: Key Management Service (KMS)
kms.description: Managed service that makes it easy to create and control cryptographic keys used to encrypt data. Integrated with most AWS services to help protect data stored in those services.
kms.use_cases:
• Data encryption
• Key management
• Compliance requirements
• Digital signing

step-functions.name: Step Functions
step-functions.description: Serverless orchestration service that lets you combine AWS Lambda functions and other AWS services to build business-critical applications. Visual workflows make it easy to build distributed applications.
step-functions.use_cases:
• Workflow orchestration
• Microservices coordination
• Data processing pipelines
• Human approval workflows
